description: 资源下载器：抓取视频号、小程序、抖音、快手、小红书、直播流、m3u8、酷狗、QQ 音乐等常见网络资源 | A GUI downloader for WeChat Channels, Douyin, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, live streams, m3u8 and music platforms
notes_cn: 官方发布的是 NSIS 安装器，本清单只解包其应用本体，不运行安装器（会跳过 uninstall.exe 与 $PLUGINSDIR 里的 WebView2 引导程序）
界面基于 WebView2：Windows 11 自带；若窗口空白，请自行安装 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime（或使用官方 *_fixed_webview2.exe 版本）
抓取 HTTPS 资源需要在应用内安装根证书，写入的是本机受信任根存储，需要以管理员身份运行才能成功
应用会临时修改系统代理（HKCU\...\Internet Settings），用完请在界面里关闭代理
配置、证书缓存在 %APPDATA%\res-downloader（已链接持久化）；下载目录由应用内设置决定；发行版未签名，首次运行可能被 SmartScreen 拦截
notes: Upstream ships an NSIS installer; this manifest only unpacks the application payload and never runs the installer (uninstall.exe and the WebView2 bootstrapper inside $PLUGINSDIR are dropped)
The UI uses WebView2: built into Windows 11; if the window stays blank, install Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime yourself (or use the official *_fixed_webview2.exe build)
Capturing HTTPS traffic requires installing the app's root certificate, which is written to the machine trusted root store and therefore needs an elevated app
The app temporarily changes the system proxy (HKCU\...\Internet Settings); turn it off in the UI when done

Config and certificate cache live in %APPDATA%\res-downloader (linked to a persisted directory); the download folder is configured inside the app; release binaries are not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn on first launch
